results.title: Knots
results.overview: A newlywed couple undergoes an unbreakable soul-binding ritual that threatens to expose something far more sinister than their love for each other.

results.title: Restless
results.overview: When hard partying and volatile neighbours move in next door, a quiet woman's life begins to spiral, pushing her to the edge and triggering a slow, unnerving descent into obsession and revenge.

results.title: Only Girls
results.overview: Noelia (Clara Alvarado) is a young woman who leaves her hometown in search of a better future. Her relationship with her father was never ideal, and she feels the need to get away. After holding several jobs, she decides to create an account on Only Girls, a platform where she gives free rein to her clients’ sexual fantasies and where there are no boundaries. One of them wants to establish a closer relationship with her, something she initially rejects. However, after he offers her a substantial sum of money, Noelia begins to wonder whether she should go through with the meeting.

results.title: CALLING 84843
results.overview: Set in the late 2000s, a payphone booth at an all-girls Catholic school stands witness to the intimate performance of its callers.

results.title: A Change In Heart
results.overview: An accomplished TV travel host is gifted a heart-shaped hourglass which gives her a second chance to revisit her past. She eventually has to choose between a new life or the life she knows before the sands of the hourglass run out.

results.title: Pixie. The New Beginning
results.overview: New in town, eleven-year-old Hania is bullied for believing in pixies. She makes friends with the outsider Michał and a real pixie, Sindri, on a quest to prove their existence. Their journey helps Hania face new beginnings and understand the power of friendship.

results.title: Music City Mistletoe
results.overview: In Nashville, a spirited songwriter and a widowed consultant clash over the fate of a music publishing office. As Christmas nears, rivalry turns to romance in this conflict-filled holiday tale where saving dreams means risking hearts.

results.title: Los muchachos
results.overview: Through a cell phone and isolated in the observatory on La Palma, Fran must face the last thing any parent wants to hear.

results.title: SIMON! The Joy of Conducting
results.original_title: Simon Rattle - Vom Glück des Dirigierens
results.overview: “As I child, I always had music in my head. I thought everybody did,” the legendary conductor Sir Simon Rattle recalls. His charming and humorous reflections on the unifying magic of conducting are complemented by interviews with well-known contemporaries and accompanied by thrilling concert footage. His music is a joy to all those who listen to it!

results.title: Picture Imperfect
results.overview: When two women cross paths under unusual circumstances, what begins as a mess of mixed signals leads to something neither of them saw coming...

results.title: Ghumpori
results.overview: Intern doctor Usha finds her beloved Megh, who had been her tutor five years ago. Megh disappeared from Usha's life without leaving any clues. Now, Megh has set up a beautiful family in a hospital cabin with Jyoti, who is in a coma. In this surreal relationship between Megh and Jyoti, Usha enters with her lingering feelings from the past toward Megh.

results.title: Lakambini, Gregoria de Jesus
results.overview: Beloved by revolutionaries Andres Bonifacio and Julio Nakpil, Lakambini Gregoria de Jesus' quest for justice mirrors the film's journey to reclaim the legacy of a forgotten heroine.

results.title: Honey, My Love, So Sweet
results.overview: In a decaying cinema in the heart of Manila, Life discovers first love through films and their new friend’s father.

results.title: Solitarium
results.overview: An epic mosaic of lonely people with crossed destinies who set their sights on Arthur Morhan, a psychoanalyst on the verge of a breakdown.

results.title: Stay
results.overview: Kiara, a PhD author on African spirituality, and Miles, a former MMA fighter turned trainer, facing the end of their marriage. They encounter supernatural forces and go from fighting one another to fighting for their lives. To survive, they must conquer darkness with love.

results.title: The Lightning Code
results.overview: Teenage inventor Miles Fletcher unlocks the lost secret to limitless energy, catching the attention of Luxos Energy, a corporation posing as heroes. Just as he perfects his invention, they betray him—stealing his work and shutting him out. With nowhere to turn, Miles must decide—give up or trust his friends and fight back. In a high-stakes battle of ingenuity vs. industry, he races to stop Luxos before they turn his discovery into a weapon.

results.title: The 3_2 Pulldown
results.overview: Rob is a desperate microbudget filmmaker who is struggling to make ends meet. When he receives a video feed from the future from Wesley, an activist who wants to change the past, Rob sees an opportunity to make a splash in the film world. With the help of technology from the future, Rob creates a film that takes the world by storm and propels him to success. However, as he becomes more and more embroiled in the world of futuristic technology, Rob must grapple with the ethical implications of his actions and the potential consequences for both himself and the future.

results.title: Chew Toy
results.overview: Tormented by the incessant barking of a neighbor's dog, a married couple finds themselves entangled in a crisis that puts their sanity, marriage, and moral convictions to the ultimate test, all unfolding just before the anticipated arrival of their first child.

results.title: Praying Mantis
results.overview: A mysterious woman prowls the city at night, drawing men into her web as she explores the dark depths of maternal instincts.
